title: NIST Roof Array: full outage (2015-01-06 to 2015-01-07)
summary: Full outage detected at NIST Roof Array (Gaithersburg, MD) over 2 day(s), 2015-01-06 to 2015-01-07. Estimated cost so far: $27.
evidence: The site produced 99% of its expected output in the two weeks before, and 1% during this problem (100% = producing what the weather allows).
About 226 kWh lost (99% of what was expected over these days), worth roughly $27 at $0.12/kWh.
likely_causes: Inverter trip (ground fault, over-temperature, grid event)
recommended_actions: Check SCADA / inverter alarm log for the trip code and time of the first fault
Confirm grid availability with the utility before dispatch (rule out a feeder outage)
If alarms allow, attempt one remote reset; otherwise dispatch a technician
On site: inspect inverter, AC disconnect and breakers; follow lockout/tagout
safety_notes: Follow site lockout/tagout and arc-flash procedures before opening any DC or AC enclosure.

title: NIST Roof Array: snow cover (2015-01-27 to 2015-01-27)
summary: Snow cover detected at NIST Roof Array (Gaithersburg, MD) over 1 day(s), 2015-01-27 to 2015-01-27. Estimated cost so far: $19.
evidence: The site produced 100% of its expected output in the two weeks before, and 4% during this problem (100% = producing what the weather allows).
It started right after freezing weather (a day that peaked at 0 °C), and output trickled on rather than stopping.
About 161 kWh lost (96% of what was expected over these days), worth roughly $19 at $0.12/kWh.
Output collapsed but didn't switch off, right after freezing weather, while the irradiance sensor still saw sun: the panels are most likely covered by snow. Usually clears on its own as it melts.
likely_causes: Snow or ice covering the modules
recommended_actions: No dispatch yet: snow usually slides or melts off within a few days
Check the forecast; if a thaw is coming, re-check output the day after
Dispatch only if output stays low two sunny days after the thaw (possible ice or snow damage)
Do not scrape modules; use only soft tools if clearing is required by contract
parts_and_tools: Soft foam snow rake (only if clearing is required)
safety_notes: Follow site lockout/tagout and arc-flash procedures before opening any DC or AC enclosure.
